source.title: The Northern Watchtower 09
source.notes: Initial extraction from the uploaded PDF. Page 1 provides the map; pages 2-19 provide room, door, monster, trap, treasure, and feature text.

general.floor: Uneven Flagstone; Balance DC 10 to charge or run; dense rubble movement penalties noted in source.
general.illumination: Average; shadowy corridors, lamps or torches in most rooms.
corridorFeatures: a: A group of demonic faces have been carved into the walls.

rooms.title: Room #1
rooms.summary: Ruined barracks with emerald claw banner and worn boot-pattern floor.
features: South secret, trapped, locked iron door to Room #7 concealed behind fungus; Rune of Fear CR 9.

rooms.title: Room #2
rooms.summary: Former cistern with shallow bowl floor carved with an elemental water symbol.
features: East secret locked simple wooden door to Room #5 behind bookcase.

rooms.title: Room #3
rooms.summary: Former wizard's conjuring room with broken magic circle and dancing shadows.
features: West trapped locked good wooden door to Room #5 with Acid Spray trap.
East locked stone door to Room #4.
South secret locked strong wooden door to Room #10.
treasure: Hidden locked iron chest; 900 gp, potions, Sovereign Glue; hoard total 3900 gp.

rooms.title: Room #4
rooms.summary: Empty room with locked, trapped, and secret exits.
features: West locked stone door to Room #3.
East trapped locked stone door with Power Word Stun trap.
South secret stuck strong wooden door to Room #11 concealed in gargantuan skull mouth.

rooms.title: Room #5
rooms.summary: Treasure room with secret doors and Acid Spray / Prismatic Spray traps.
features: Secret west doors to Room #2 and hidden maiden-statue door.
East trapped locked door to Room #3.
South trapped locked strong wooden door with Prismatic Spray.
treasure: Hidden unlocked good wooden chest; 1000 gp and Wand of Fox's Cunning; hoard total 2080 gp.

rooms.title: Room #6
rooms.summary: Urine-scented chamber with rusted breastplate and magical scrying pool.
features: South Guillotine Blade trap to Room #8.
Scrying pool shows two children arguing over whose stick is better.
treasure: 13 pp and assorted valuables; hoard total 1230 gp.

rooms.title: Room #7
rooms.summary: Empty chamber with fungus and statue-concealed secret exits.
features: North secret Rune of Fear door to Room #1.

rooms.title: Room #8
rooms.summary: Empty secret-connection room linking 6, 7, 9, and 16.
features: North Guillotine Blade door to Room #6.
East hydra-statue secret door to Room #9.

rooms.title: Room #9
rooms.summary: Trap room with Earthquake trap and locked exits.

rooms.title: Room #10
rooms.summary: Former gathering hall with stone table and massive hearth.
features: East secret trapped door to Room #11 with Dropping Ceiling.

rooms.title: Room #11
rooms.summary: Empty room connected by secret doors and locked south passage.
features: North secret skull-mouth door to Room #4.
West Dropping Ceiling door to Room #10.

rooms.title: Room #12
rooms.summary: Centipede lair behind locked stone door.

rooms.title: Room #13
rooms.summary: Rat swarm room with sarcophagus-concealed exit.
features: South secret sarcophagus door to Room #18.

rooms.title: Room #14
rooms.summary: Room with battle mural ceiling and altar of evil.

rooms.title: Room #15
rooms.summary: Mirror trick room.
features: East Rune of Fear door to Room #16.
Magical mirror answers with lies and falsehoods.

rooms.title: Room #16
rooms.summary: Former gallery with defaced statues and baleful runes.
features: West Rune of Fear door to Room #15.

rooms.title: Room #17
rooms.summary: Bone-strewn chamber with hidden treasure.
features: East doors to secret area and Room #20.
South Burnt Othur Vapor and pit-trap doors.
treasure: Hidden chest: pp, gemstones, scrolls, Wand of Hold Person; hoard total 4315 gp.

rooms.title: Room #18
rooms.summary: Skum-occupied room with sarcophagus door and Acid Fog exit.
features: South Acid Fog trap to Room #23.
treasure: Hidden locked iron chest; 60000 cp, scrolls, Potion of Delay Poison; hoard total 1100 gp.

rooms.title: Room #19
rooms.summary: Trap room with poisoned arrow turret.
features: South trapped doors to Room #23 and Room #24.

rooms.title: Room #20
rooms.summary: Room with balcony stair, curse graffiti, and many doors.
features: North wall text: The curse can never be broken.

rooms.title: Room #21
rooms.summary: Room with stone dais and battle tapestry.

rooms.title: Room #22
rooms.summary: Centipede room with Blade Barrier south door.

rooms.title: Room #23
rooms.summary: Empty room connected to 18, 19, 24, and 29.
features: North trapped doors to Rooms #18 and #19.

rooms.title: Room #24
rooms.summary: Empty transition room to Rooms #19, #23, and #30.
features: North Dropping Ceiling door to Room #19.
South locked iron door to Room #30.

rooms.title: Room #25
rooms.summary: Former arsenal scarred by fire and lightning.
features: East Incendiary Cloud door to Room #26.

rooms.title: Room #26
rooms.summary: Vampire spawn room with treasure and hidden treasure.
features: West Incendiary Cloud door to Room #25.

rooms.title: Room #27
rooms.summary: Room with shallow pit and rotten bread.
features: Wide-Mouth Spiked Pit with Poisoned Spikes CR 9.

rooms.title: Room #28
rooms.summary: Empty room with north locked door and east secret exit.
features: East secret skull-pile door to Room #29.

rooms.title: Room #29
rooms.summary: Former summoning room with broken magic circle and water-sound pressure trigger trick.

rooms.title: Room #30
rooms.summary: Minotaur room with red stone spirals and trap-reset clue.

treasure: 220 pp; Arcane Scroll (Spectral Hand); hoard total 2350 gp.
